title: Mastering ECG Interpretation: A Visual Guide
summary: This comprehensive visual guide provides a clear framework for ECG interpretation with diagrams, focusing on wave morphology, timing intervals, and rhythm identification. It is designed to facilitate rapid clinical assessment and accurate diagnostic reasoning.

sections.title: The Core Subject
sections.content: This resource focuses on the essential principles of ECG interpretation with diagrams, ensuring a systematic approach to reading electrocardiograms in a clinical setting.

sections.title: Calculating Heart Rate
content: Step 1: Find an R wave on a heavy grid line.
Step 2: Count large squares to the next R wave.
Step 4: For irregular rhythms, count R waves in 6 seconds and multiply by 10.

sections.title: Red Flag Findings
content: Prolonged QT Interval (Risk of Torsades de Pointes)

content.explanation: Rate: Fast or slow?; Rhythm: Regular or irregular?; Axis: Normal, Left, or Right?; Hypertrophy: Ventricular or Atrial?; Infarction: ST changes or Q waves?

sections.title: The Visual Glossary
content: ECG interpretation with diagrams: The cornerstone of cardiac diagnostics.
Isoelectric Line: The baseline from which all waves deviate.
12-Lead View: Provides a 3D electrical perspective of the heart.
